$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Compact Claude Chats settings: when acpmux compacts a Claude chat around its prompt cache (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/cache_compact.rs): before the cache expires (a timer on an idle chat, while the cache is still warm) or when you return (the next message, once the cache expired, compacts first). The daemon reads these keys from the settings file each time it arms the timer or sends a message and checks this file's defaults and ranges in its tests; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: agentCache
lists.note: Settings > General > Prompt Cache (Leo, 2026-11-03: "idk if we maybe also wanna be showing that/opt-in autocompact around that 5min mark"; "we ought to make these all accessibly toggle-able ofc"). Off by default: a compaction is a model call that counts toward usage.

rows.name: cacheCompactMode
rows.note: When acpmux compacts a Claude chat. Absent: agents.cacheCompact.enabled decides (true is beforeExpiry, else off). Off by default: a compaction is a model call that counts toward usage.

help.text: A compacted chat's next message costs less.

choices.note: acpmux never compacts a chat on its own.
An idle chat over agents.cacheCompact.minContextPercent runs /compact about 30 s before its prompt cache expires (once per idle stretch; never mid-turn, with a prompt queued, or while someone types).
The first message sent after the prompt cache expired, to a chat over agents.cacheCompact.returnMinTokens, runs /compact first and is sent after it.

rows.name: cacheCompactEnabled
rows.note: Legacy switch, replaced by agents.cacheCompact.mode (its row is hidden on the Settings page): when mode is absent, true means "beforeExpiry" and false (the default) means "off". A set mode wins over it.

help.text: Compacts an idle Claude chat while its cache is warm, so the next message costs less.

rows.name: cacheCompactMinContext
rows.note: The share of the context window (percent) a chat must be using before the timer compacts it.

help.text: Chats using less of their context window than this are left as they are.

rows.name: cacheCompactReturnMinTokens
rows.note: When You Return only: the context size (tokens) a chat must be over before its first message after the cache expired compacts it first.

help.text: Smaller chats are sent without compacting.
